scope: Official traditional projection artifact and run provenance verification only
negative_projection_semantics: Un[:, kn:] @ Un[:, kn:].T; independent negative-covariance complement, not I minus the positive projector
checkpoint_claim: Matches the recorded run checkpoint; this does not establish equivalence to the paper Qwen3-8B-Base checkpoint
effective_row_count_basis: Official synthetic builder iterates min(requested max_samples, file line count); verified exit code 0
calibration_row_count_caveat: Up to two triplets per row; a skipped span can remove a triplet. Forward count does not identify which rows survived.
